info.title: Rover Controller REST API
info.description: Player/controller API. Copy your API key from the Account page and use Authorize (paste the key without the Bearer prefix). Start a development or mission round, read sensors, then issue one action at a time. Starting a new round replaces the active one; sensor and beacon reads consume energy. The rover starts on a random floor cell facing east. No landing coordinates, map or target list are supplied in controller state. Reach targets 1 → 2 → 3; full-map exploration is not required.

get.summary: Poll the current round and finalize any action whose end time has passed.
get.description:
Wait for activeAction=null before sending the next action. Calls advance the
simulation clock: passive energy drain and time penalties are applied.
A generic success message does not rule out a silent movement/rotation failure.

post.summary: Queue one action. Acceptance does not mean the action has finished.
post.description:
Move/rotate: ~1s, 1 energy. Wait: ~2s, 1 energy, plus solar charging.
Collect rock/soil: ~2s, 2 energy, on the sample's cell. Analyze: ~3s, 3 energy.
Durations vary ±15%. Movement/rotation may silently fail (6%, 12% on gravel
for movement); verify using GPS/IMU after activeAction becomes null.

200.description: Action accepted; poll current state until idle

409.description: Rover busy or round no longer active

422.description: Unknown or missing action (plain-text validation error)

get.summary: Read the navigation beacon for the next target, available with any loadout.
get.description:
Costs 1 energy in an active round, including ~10% signal dropouts.
Bearing is relative to the rover: positive=right, negative=left, zero=ahead.
Distance is in cells, in a straight line, not a traversable route.
Gaussian noise has standard deviations 8° and 1.5 cells, not hard bounds.
When inactive, all three values are null and no reading energy is charged.

200.description: Approximate direction and distance to next target

get.summary: Read selected installed sensors. Each requested, installed sensor costs 1 energy.
get.description:
Every omitted selection flag defaults to true. For a GPS-only reading set
gps=true AND depthCamera=false, imu=false, sampleDetector=false.
Uninstalled/unselected sensors are omitted. Signal dropout still costs energy.
Calls advance simulation time. Coordinates use a top-left origin, x east, y south.

200.description: Requested installed sensors and server time

post.summary: Stop the current round immediately, cancelling any pending rover action.

get.summary: List equipment, mass and score penalties. Maximum mass is 6 kg.

example.mission: Atinge cele trei ținte în ordine. Evită pereții și craterele. Pietrișul costă mai mult și eșuează mai des (12%). Comenzile de deplasare pot eșua tăcut: verifică poziția (GPS) și capul (IMU). Probe de rocă/sol: fiecare zăcământ se epuizează după 1-3 colectări (aleator pe rundă).

beacon.bearing: relative to rover heading; positive=right, negative=left

startup.coordinates: Origin (0,0) at top-left; x increases east, y increases south. North=0, east=90, south=180, west=270 degrees.
startup.navigation: GPS provides position when installed and receiving a signal; IMU provides heading. The beacon is available with any loadout and points only to the next target.
startup.objective: Reach targets 1, 2, 3 in order; full-map exploration is not required. Samples are optional bonus points.
startup.position: random floor cell; coordinates are not included in controller state

put.summary: Start a round immediately with the submitted equipment.
put.description:
Development uses a random map; mission uses the fixed evaluation map.
A random starting position and eastward heading are chosen, but coordinates,
orientation and map are omitted from this response. No waypoint list is supplied.
Replaces an active round, deducting 150 points per remaining target from it.

422.description: Invalid request fields or enum values (plain-text validation error)

bearingDeg.description:
Relative bearing: positive=right, negative=left. Gaussian noise σ=8°;
it can exceed ±180° after noise. Null on dropout or an inactive round.

distance.description: Straight-line distance in cells, clamped to >=0. Gaussian noise σ=1.5.

target.description: Next target (1-3), or null when the round is inactive.

oneOf.description: Null on signal loss. Blocked means wall OR crater.

cells.description: One cell ahead and three at distance two; absolute grid coordinates.

dropout.description: Near-cell dropout probability (0.1); far cells have probability 0.2.

GameView.description:
Controller state. Position, orientation and map are obtained through sensors,
not through this response. The browser's additional fields are not part of this contract.

oneOf.description: Null when idle. Poll until null before issuing another action.

target.description: Number of targets reached in order (0-3), not the next target's number.

headingDeg.description: Exact heading: north=0, east=90, south=180, west=270.

distance.description: 1 or 2 cells ahead. Move onto the sample's cell to collect it.

oneOf.description: Null if no sample is detected or the reading fails (~10%).
Omitted unless requested and installed; null on signal dropout (~20%).

gain.description: Gross energy added by wait: 8/14 in sunlight, 0 without a panel or in shade.
